duration: 12 months from the date of this Agreement, automatically renewable unless either party notifies intent not to renew.

financial_value.payment_terms: Total contract value, payable in monthly installments of USD 8,000.

termination_clauses: Either party may terminate with 30 days' prior written notice.
penalty_clauses: Service credit of 2% of the monthly fee for each additional day of downtime beyond the agreed SLA threshold.
governing_law: Laws of the United Arab Emirates as applied in the DIFC.
language_precedence_clause: In case of conflict, the Arabic version shall prevail.
